task_instruction: Given a service-request policy question, retrieve the relevant policy or procedure passage that answers the request.

documents.title: Remote Work
documents.text: Employees assigned to Jakarta may work remotely for up to 2 days in a calendar week. The employee must agree the schedule with their line manager before each remote day.

documents.title: Annual Leave Requests
documents.text: Annual leave requests should be submitted at least 5 business days before the first leave date. An urgent exception must include a reason and is reviewed by the line manager.

documents.title: Standard Application Access
documents.text: Standard non-privileged application access requires line-manager approval and must use the least-privilege role needed for the employee's work. Access is reviewed every 90 days.

documents.title: Temporary Privileged Access
documents.text: Temporary administrator access requires approval from both the service owner and Information Security. Each privileged session is limited to 8 hours and must be linked to an approved case.

documents.title: Critical Incident Escalation
documents.text: A complete customer-facing service outage or an incident affecting all users is classified as critical. Report it through the emergency service-desk channel within 15 minutes of discovery.

documents.title: Routine Incident Reporting
documents.text: A single-user issue with a working alternative is handled as a routine incident. Submit it through the standard service portal within 1 business day and include the affected service and observed error.

documents.title: Master Data Changes
documents.text: A master-data change requires a verified change form and an approver who did not prepare the request. Supplier bank-account changes also require a 2nd verification against the registered bank letter.

documents.title: Case Status Responses
documents.text: A requester may obtain the current case status by providing the case reference. A status response may show the current state and last public update but must exclude confidential approval notes.

documents.title: Service Request Attachment Retention
documents.text: Attachments submitted with a service request are retained for 90 days after the case is closed. They are then deleted unless an active legal hold requires longer retention.

documents.title: Password Reset Identity Check
documents.text: Before resetting a password, the service agent must verify the requester with 2 approved identity factors. The agent must never ask the requester to disclose the current password.
